ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft IIS Service Account Password Dumped
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the Internet Information Services (IIS) command-line tool, AppCmd, being used to list passwords

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\appcmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "appcmd\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*list\\ .*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/config.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/xml.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-config.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-xml.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/\\@t.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/text.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/show.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\@t.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-text.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-show.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\*.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*password.*"))))
